title: Harden Pullback v0.2 guidance-only containment
objective: Implement the smallest static contract/consumer guard proving current active code and prompts do not use qualitative Pullback v0.2 labels as standalone mechanical action, rebuy, recovery-failure or calibration authority while the policy remains GUIDANCE_ONLY. Do not invent numeric bands or triggers.
primary_target: tests/governance/directly related pullback guidance containment test
allowed_change_scope: tests/governance/directly related Pullback v0.2 containment tests
scripts/governance/directly related static pullback containment validator if required
01_CORE_FRAMEWORK/directly related non-semantic machine-readable containment status artifact if existing routing requires it

evidence.summary: Canonical owner suspends mechanical classification authority, forbids action from qualitative labels alone and forbids invented numeric bands.
Program finding chooses containment over invented specification while provenance remains incomplete.

reproduction: On fresh main, confirm Pullback v0.2 remains GUIDANCE_ONLY and no deterministic repository guard currently demonstrates that active consumers cannot map Mild/Moderate/Large/Extreme directly to action/rebuy/calibration semantics without the required reproducibility fields.

positive: Descriptive pullback-label usage that preserves GUIDANCE_ONLY semantics passes the guard.
A future owner-authorized mechanically derived artifact is not rejected merely for using a label when all required reproducibility fields and authority are explicit.
negative: Fixture mapping Moderate directly to REDUCE fails.
Fixture using a qualitative label alone as rebuy unlock, recovery-failure state or calibration HIT/MISS fails.
